distinguishing_features: Transient sacrificial gas-pressurized internal cavity for active counter-bending
Integration with existing LPBF gas systems for pressure modulation
Physics-based moment equilibrium (M_gas ≈ M_th) to nullify distortion
Design modification (internal cavity/orifice) without new material classes
parsed.objective_technical_problem: Mitigating residual stress-induced distortion in LPBF parts during support removal without new hardware or material changes
parsed.viable_reason: The solution leverages existing LPBF gas systems with pressure/flow control to generate counter-moments, validated by moment equilibrium calculations and feasible pressure ranges via regulator bypass.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: The use of internal gas cavities for active counter-bending during support removal is not disclosed in prior art, which focuses on monitoring, material changes, or procedural restrictions rather than physics-based design-integrated stress compensation.
